description:
Configure JStock's email notification system for price alerts. Open the Options dialog (via Edit > Options or similar menu), navigate to the Email/Alert tab, and configure the following SMTP settings:

- SMTP Server: smtp.gmail.com
- SMTP Port: 587
- Username: portfolio.alerts@gmail.com
- Password: JStock2024Alert!
- Check 'Enable email' if required.

Do not click 'Send Test Email'. Click OK to save the settings.
